description: Coulombic potential with distance cutoff (CUTCP), cutoff-binning implementation. Atoms are geometrically hashed into a 4 A lattice of bins; the potential lattice is computed in 8^3-point regions where each thread block walks only neighboring bins within the cutoff (constant-memory NbrList stencil) staging bins through shared memory. Faithful port of the Parboil cuda kernel cuda_cutoff_potential_lattice6overlap; emits per-iteration kernel times.

scaling_param.name: num_atoms
scaling_param.description: Number of charged atoms hashed into the bin lattice

non_scaling_params.name: grid_spacing
non_scaling_params.description: Lattice spacing h in Angstroms (0.5 keeps BIN_LENGTH/(8h)=1)

non_scaling_params.name: cutoff_radius
non_scaling_params.description: Cutoff distance for charge interactions in Angstroms

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
